claims.text: In the King's Letter, King Elessar mentions his name in Sindarin as Iorhael.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), Sauron Defeated, "Part One: The End of the Third Age: XI. The Epilogue: The second version"

claims.text: It was always Sam's intention to name one of his children after his best friend, Frodo Baggins. Though his first child was a girl, he named the second one Frodo.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "The Grey Havens"

claims.text: Frodo became the head of Gardner Family and inherited Bag End. His son was Holfast Gardner.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "The Longfather-tree of Master Samwise"
